purpose: Hero photograph for a private concept website pitch for De Happertjes snackbar
prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: editorial food photograph for a private concept website hero, not a photograph of an actual business.
Primary request: appetizing, realistic Dutch kibbeling with crisp French fries, a lemon wedge and a small portion of creamy dipping sauce, served together in one simple unbranded takeaway tray.
Scene/backdrop: a plain seaside counter with a softly blurred coastal background suggesting Scheveningen on the Dutch North Sea. Natural daylight with a gentle coastal feel.
Subject and textures: irregular bite-size pieces of battered white fish with finely detailed golden crisp crust, properly cooked tender white fish where naturally visible; fresh golden fries with crisp edges, fresh lemon, sauce in one small plain cup. Realistic portions and small natural imperfections, professional editorial food texture.
Composition/framing: horizontal landscape approximately 3:2, ideally 1536 by 1024 pixels. Close three-quarter view; keep the complete tray and the food clearly visible, with restrained breathing room. Food remains the sharp focal point; background stays unobtrusive.
Style: photorealistic professional food photography, honest natural colors, softly directional daylight, realistic shadows, no artificial glossy rendering.
Constraints: exactly one finished photograph. No text, lettering, logos, branding, watermark, people or hands. No Latin American food scene, tacos, tortillas, burgers, unrelated food or extra decorative props.
conversion: Only proportional resizing and WebP encoding; no cropping, compositing or visual edits
